word.kin.text: By the by — would you carry a word to my {rel} {R}, {a_trade} here in {town}? Tell {them} {msg}.
If your way takes you past my {rel} {R}, {a_trade} here in {town}, would you tell {them} {msg}?
A small favour, if you would. My {rel} {R} works as {a_trade} here in {town}. Tell {them} {msg}.

word.cousin.text: You travel more than I do. Would you carry a word to my cousin {R}, {a_trade} in {town}? Tell {them} {msg}.
If the road ever takes you to {town}, my cousin {R} is {a_trade} there. Would you tell {them} {msg}?
A favour, if you are willing. My cousin {R} is {a_trade} in {town}. Tell {them} {msg}.

word.standin.text: My {O_rel} {O} lives in {town}, further than my work lets me go. Would you carry word to {R}, {a_trade} there, to pass on? Tell {them} {msg}.
I cannot get to {town}, where my {O_rel} {O} lives. {R}, {a_trade} there, sees everyone. Would you ask {R} to tell {them} {msg}?
A favour, if you would. {R} is {a_trade} in {town} and can get word to my {O_rel} {O}. The word is this: {msg}.

ask_after.kin.text: Would you look in on my {rel} {R}, {a_trade} here in {town}, and bring me word of how {R} fares? I would rest easier for it.
I would be glad of word of my {rel} {R}. {R} is {a_trade} here in {town}. Would you ask after {them} and tell me what you hear?

ask_after.cousin.text: Would you look in on my {rel} {R}, {a_trade} in {town}, and bring me word of how {R} fares? I would rest easier for it.
I would be glad of word of my {rel} {R}. {R} is {a_trade} in {town}. Would you ask after {them} and tell me what you hear?
If you pass through {town}, would you ask after my {rel} {R}, {a_trade} there, and bring the answer back to me?

introduce.contact.text: You have been good company. If you are ever in {town}, look for {R}, {a_trade} like myself. Say that {S} of {S_town} sent you.
There is someone you should know. {R} is {a_trade} in {town}, same trade as mine. Tell {them} {S} of {S_town} sent you.
If your road leads to {town}, seek out {R}, {a_trade} there. Give {them} my name — {S} of {S_town}.

msg.text: that I am keeping busy and think of {them} often
that the door is always open to {them}
that I wish {them} fair weather and good custom
that all is quiet here and I have no complaints
that I was thinking of {them} only this morning
that I hope the season is treating {them} kindly
that there is a place at my table whenever {their} road allows
that I send my good wishes, and more of them than I can say
that the days are full here, and I am glad of it
to mind the roads and keep a warm hearth
that I count myself lucky in my kin
that {their} name is spoken kindly at my table
that the road between us is long, but my thoughts make the journey
that I have not forgotten {them}, whatever the distance

yes.text: That is good of you. Safe roads.
My thanks. I will not forget the kindness.
Good. It is a weight off my mind already.

no.text: Think nothing of it. Another time, perhaps.
As you like. I only thought to ask.

neutral.text: Hm. Never mind — it will keep.
Ah, forgive me, my mind wandered. Another time.
No, leave it for now. It is no great matter.

word.kin.text: Word from my {rel_back} {S}? That is good to have. Thank you for bringing it.
{S} sent you? My {rel_back} does not forget me, then. You have my thanks.
From {S}, my {rel_back}? You have brightened my day by carrying it.

word.standin.text: For {O}, from {S}? Leave it with me. I will see that it is passed on.
A word for {O}? I will pass it on. Thank you for carrying it.
From {S} of {S_town}, for {O}. I have it, and I will pass it on.

ask_after.text: {S} asks after me? Tell my {rel_back} {said}. You will find me at my work as {a_trade} here in {town}.
So my {rel_back} {S} worries. Tell {S} {said}, and that I am {a_trade} here in {town}.
Kind of {S} to ask. Say this from me: {said}. And that {a_trade} in {town} has no time for idleness.

introduce.text: {S} of {S_town} sent you? Then you are welcome here. Any friend of {S} may count on a fair hearing from me.
From {S}, is it? We are of one trade, {S} and I. You are welcome.
{S} of {S_town} speaks for you? That is enough for me. Well met.

answer.said: that all is well with me here
that I am kept busy, and glad of it
answer.reported: {R} is kept busy, and glad of it

answer.said: not to fret on my account
answer.reported: that I am not to fret

answer.said: that I have no complaints worth the carrying
answer.reported: {R} has no complaints worth the carrying

answer.said: that the days are full and the nights are quiet
answer.reported: that the days are full there and the nights quiet

answer.said: that I think of home often, and kindly
answer.reported: {R} thinks of home often, and kindly

answer.said: that I am content, and wish the same for all of you
answer.reported: {R} is content, and wishes the same for us

answer.said: that the work goes on and so do I
answer.reported: that the work goes on, and {R} with it

return.text: You saw {R}? And the word is {reported} — and still at work as {a_trade} in {town}. Thank you. That eases my mind.
So — {reported}, and {a_trade} in {town} yet. I am glad to hear it, and grateful to you for the journey.
{R} sends back {reported}? Good. Good. {a_trade} in {town}, and thriving on it by the sound. My thanks.

reward.text: I am no rich soul, friend, but a kindness done me seldom goes unpaid.

as_heard.text: I have said my piece. Carry it as you heard it.

thanks.text: You made the journey, then. Thank you — it means a great deal to me that you went.
Back already? You have my thanks for going. It was kindly done.
So you went all that way for me. I will not forget it.

system.taken: You have agreed to carry word for {S}. Say [Errands to see what you are carrying.
system.paid: The errand for {S} is done. You receive {n} gold.
system.pack_full: You have no room for the {n} gold you are owed. Make room, then say [Errands collect.
system.collected: You collect {n} gold owed for errands.
system.collect_paused: Errand pay is paused just now. The {n} gold you are owed is safe.
system.past_limit: You have done all the paid errands you can for today. This one earns thanks alone.
system.lapsed: Too long has passed. The errand for {S} has lapsed.
system.dropped: You set aside the errand for {S}.
system.cannot_deliver: That errand cannot be delivered just now.
system.see_log: Say [Errands to see what you are carrying.
system.more_than_one: You carry more than one errand that concerns {S}. Say [Errands to see them.
system.not_recalled: The exact words cannot be recalled just now.
